label: Local Signal cold open
prompt:

Speaker A: That is the point. A small studio should own the weights and the cuts.
Speaker B: Edit the script before you generate speech. The edit is the human part.

prompt:

Speaker B: If the card dies, the show dies with it.

label: No cloud voices
prompt:

Speaker B: No rented music either.

label: One job
prompt:

label: Rain hour
prompt:

label: Night desk
prompt:

label: Card runs hot
prompt:

label: No rented bed
prompt:

label: Look twice

label: Harbor hour
prompt:

label: Workshop hour
prompt:

label: Quiet street
prompt:

label: Stop first

label: Own the silence

label: End on the work
prompt:

label: Welcome back
prompt:

label: One job reminder
prompt: One GB10 job. Stop the other family before you Queue. Original characters only. Disclosure stays in metadata.

label: Stock voices only
prompt: Use stock Kokoro identities. No celebrity refs. Empty clone refs fall back to Kokoro.

label: Instrumental beds
prompt: ACE beds stay instrumental: no vocals tags, empty lyrics. Do not pull the turbo AIO twice.

label: Rights on Queue
prompt: Queue only with rights. No living-artist style tags. No existing song titles.

label: Keep the length
prompt: Respect the duration widget. Do not type a 30-minute latent. CPU TTS is slow at 25 min.

label: Handoff next
prompt: After this Queue, hand off to the next lab App in the occupancy chip. Do not stack families.

label: Unmarked surfaces
prompt: Keep surfaces unmarked. Empty of lettering unless the App is text-swap.

label: Original characters
prompt: Hosts and subjects are original. No real-person names. No clone of a living voice.

label: On-box only
prompt: Stay on-box. No cloud APIs. GGUF rewrite is optional; Custom uses the widget text.

label: Spark still first
prompt: If you need a still, Queue a Klein App first, then this graph. One family on the GPU.
